mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the CPIAUCSL index above 302 signals accelerating inflation, triggering selling pressure and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite CPIAUCSL crossing above 302, or the inflationary spike is not sustained (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in unemployment benefits claims (UNRATE) creates a conflicting yet convergent signal toward economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite the combined signal, or the trigger conditions are not met in the data.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces policy tightness, enhancing equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS decline in the regime.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in UNRATE above 4% signals rising labor costs and wage pressures, leading to market pessimism and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0, or the unemployment rate does not sustain the increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDP personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) reflects robust demand growth, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 trend upward.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in both GDP personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust demand across sectors, amplifying market optimism and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase by >5% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative despite both proxies rising significantly, or the increases are not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate coupled with rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates easing monetary policy and stronger supply-side activity, converging to drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite the combined signal, or trigger conditions not met.
